mechanism: Topical prednisolone has minimal systemic absorption, but systemic corticosteroids can promote urinary potassium loss and hypokalemia; ophthalmic formulation presents negligible risk but caution warranted with concurrent supplementation.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels if using ophthalmic prednisolone concurrently with potassium supplementation, particularly with prolonged ocular corticosteroid use or if patient has renal impairment.
